scope: All 172 existing P manufacturing-process step rows in catalog/route_steps.csv; N material-family routes excluded. P13/P14 have no CSV step rows and are identified separately as capability-only fallback recommendations.
method: Manual semantic review of every supplied equipment_sequence, category list, and preserved source locator. No new external source claims, operating settings, or guessed equipment classes are introduced.

semantics.required_branches: OR across branches; AND within each branch; repeated category IDs represent multiple physical slots within that stage.
semantics.empty_branch: No classified machine is required for this branch, but its handling/development/ambient operation remains part of the sequence.
semantics.optional_category_ids: Always display these optional class slots; do not globally require them. If an optional branch is selected, all categories listed together in optional_branches belong to that branch.
semantics.unresolved_required_equipment: The supplied row explicitly requires apparatus for which a suitable classified slot is absent. Do not report equipment-plan completion until the requirement is reviewed and resolved.
semantics.readiness_review_required: Cross-step branch dependency, conditional capability, concurrency, or source ambiguity is not resolved by independent slot filling. Show review-needed instead of asserting feasibility.
semantics.reuse: The same physical instrument can occur at multiple stages. Repeated stages do not automatically multiply physical units or price. Distinct duplicate IDs WITHIN one required branch do represent simultaneous physical slots.
semantics.readiness: At most an equipment-plan completeness indicator; does not validate chemistry, controls, timing, capacities, compatibility, hazards, or actual manufacturing success.
